class Dispenser
Character row
Character column

VendingMachine 1 -- * slots DispenserA Dispenser called slots has A VendingMachine. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one VendingMachine.A VendingMachine has some Dispensers called slots. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a Dispenser is created, its VendingMachine must be assigned. When a Dispenser is deleted, its VendingMachine is not deleted and its list of Dispensers is decreased. When a VendingMachine is deleted, its Dispensers are not deleted. They are assigned to another VendingMachine.
